title: Classic UI Changelog
description: Changelog for OSR Studio Classic UI (classic-ui branch)

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed overlay preview not respecting Display property for keystrokes and elapsed time overlays

sections.title: Rebranding
items: Complete rebrand from nCaptura to OSR Studio
Updated application name, icons, and branding throughout
New classic logo with light/dark theme variants
Maintained classic UI layout and functionality
Refreshed GitHub repository with new identity

sections.title: Documentation
items: Updated all documentation to reflect OSR Studio branding
Enhanced README with better project description

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Restored mouse left button down event to video source picker window
Fixed various UI inconsistencies after rebranding
